Name: SteelSeries Battery
Description: Displays battery levels for supported SteelSeries wireless mice and Arctis GameBuds.

com.cookienomster.steelseriesbatteryplug.Name: Mouse Battery
com.cookienomster.steelseriesbatteryplug.Tooltip: Shows the battery level and charging state of a supported SteelSeries wireless mouse.

com.cookienomster.steelseriesbatteryplug.Name: Arctis GameBuds Battery
com.cookienomster.steelseriesbatteryplug.Tooltip: Shows the left and right Arctis GameBuds battery levels.

com.cookienomster.steelseriesbatteryplug.Name: Battery Dial
com.cookienomster.steelseriesbatteryplug.Tooltip: Rotate the dial to switch between all supported mice and headsets.
